label: Google Play
description: Play Billing for the Android app. The website checkout provider stays Stripe.

settings.name: package_name
settings.label: Package name
settings.help: Android application id. Purchases are confirmed against this package.

settings.name: service_account_file
settings.label: Service account file
settings.help: Absolute path to the Play Console service-account JSON. The file stays outside the site and is not committed.

settings.name: notify_audience
settings.label: Notification audience
settings.help: Exact https address configured as the Pub/Sub push audience for google/notify. Empty ignores every notification.
